bio: I was born on October 19, 1978 in Burgas, Bulgaria. Grew up in the small town of Pomorie on the coast of the Black Sea. I studied art history and cultural studies at the New Bulgarian University in Sofia. Started taking photos actively and dedicatedly in 1998. In 1999 I became a co-founder and member of photo group Naos. From 2001 to 2009, the group organized and participated in numerous joint exhibitions. Since 2015, I have been working mainly in the genres of street and documentary photography as part of my own personal projects.
